Chapter 28

Chapter 28: Call Me ‘Sister’; Medical Water Illustration Book

Beep!

The bank card swiped gently on the POS machine, making a pleasant sound.

When this sound rang out, Song Yi, Zheng Jinbao, and Ma Zhong all came back to their senses.

A car!

He bought a Mercedes-Benz G-Class worth more than two million yuan just like that?

Had it been three minutes from entering the shop to paying?

Even if one were to buy clothes that cost 100 yuan, it would not be that fast, right?

The three of them looked at Lin Fan with a look of admiration.

God Lin Fan!

Song Yi let out a deep sigh, his face full of hesitation.

“Song Yi, what’s wrong?” Lin Fan asked.

“I just wanted to say that I could’ve run that errand too,” Song Yi said.

He was not spouting nonsense.

He had always liked cars.

He used to work in a 4S shop during the summer break.

Getting a car plate number was not difficult for him at all.

Lin Fan smiled. “How can I let you do such a small thing? You have the potential to do great things in the future.”

Small thing?

If he could get 200,000 yuan just by applying for a license plate once, then…

Song Yi expressed that he wanted to do such small things for the rest of his life!

After that, Lin Fan got into his car as the salesperson respectfully sent him off.

Soon, they arrived at Penglai Seafood Restaurant.

Penglai Seafood Restaurant was a famous seafood restaurant in Jiangbei. The entire restaurant was shaped like a huge octopus.

The air in the shop was filled with the salty fragrance of the sea.

Ma Zhong pointed at the crab not far away and said, “What a huge crab!”

“It’s obviously waiting for us to eat it.” Zheng Jinbao swallowed his saliva.

“Alright, then I’ll have four crabs, four Australian lobsters, four pounds of mantis shrimp, and four pounds of giant oysters. As for the cooking method, you can do it however you like as long as the food tastes good,” Lin Fan said.

Even though Lin Fan had only spent two days with his roommates …

It was fate that they met.

Furthermore, Lin Fan could feel that they were decent people.

Therefore, he was willing to treat them to some good food.

Of course, this was nothing much to Lin Fan.

The waiter at the side noted down the orders one by one.

Then, Lin Fan and the others were arranged to sit in a spacious private room.

The chefs at Penglai Seafood Restaurant did things very efficiently. In just 10 minutes, a seafood feast with good color, smell, and taste was served.

Zheng Jinbao, Song Yi, and Ma Zhong looked at the delicious food and could not help but swallow their saliva.

“Let’s eat,” Lin Fan said with a smile.

“We won’t be polite, then.” The three of them chuckled.

As he spoke, Zheng Jinbao directly stuffed a giant oyster into his mouth and praised it, “Delicious!”

Song Yi picked up a palm-sized mantis shrimp and turned on his phone, “Friends from WeChat, hello! I’m going to do an eating show for everyone now. I’ll eat this mantis shrimp in one bite! Please remember to like my post!”

After saying that, he quickly removed the shell of the palm-sized mantis shrimp and stuffed it into his mouth.

Ma Zhong picked up the plate filled with crabs and gnawed on them.

…

Jiangbei University, Dorm 502 of the female dormitory.

The beautiful twins were lying on the bed, holding their phones. They looked at each other and then opened their phones to send messages.

Red: [Mom, you there?]

Blue: [mom, you there?]

Beautiful Yan: [How many times have I told you? You have to call me ‘Sister’!]

Red and Blue: [We have a boy we like.]

Beautiful Yan: [There’s a boy you like? Did he kiss you? Did he sleep with you? Don’t tell me you already have a baby?]

Red and Blue: [If you keep talking like this, we won’t tell you anything else.]

Beautiful Yan: [Alright, alright. Tell me quickly. Who is it that has attracted my two younger sisters?]

There was no need for the beautiful twins to explain. Their mother already knew that the two of them definitely liked the same person.

That was because they had the same hobbies since they were young.

Red and Blue: [We don’t know who he is either.]

Beautiful Yan: [Then how did you guys fall for him?]

Red: [He’s tall, handsome, and a hero!]

Blue: [Also, he can play basketball. He saved us.]

Beautiful Yan: [Basketball? Very tall? Very handsome? He does sound attractive. By the way, did he confess to you guys?]

Red: [I still don’t know if he likes me or not.]

Blue: [But we added him on WeChat.]

Beautiful Yan: [Then there’s definitely no problem! Oh right, give me his WeChat username.]

However, after a long time, no one replied.

Beautiful Yan: [Hey, hey, where are you guys? What about his WeChat username?]

The twin beauties did not even care about her. They were staring at Lin Fan’s chat box.

After a long time, they opened the dialog box and quickly typed a message.

Red: [Hey, are you asleep? Thank you for stopping the basketball and saving me.]

Blue: [Hi, are you asleep? Thank you for stopping the basketball and saving me.]

The two of them wrote a long paragraph of words, but when their slender fingers were getting closer and closer to the send button, they could not press it no matter what.

It was as if there was an invisible wall between their fingers and the screen.

…

The female dormitory, Dorm 606.

Sitting by the window, a beautiful girl in a white dress was reading an economics book seriously.

After a long time, she put down her book, picked up her phone, and casually scrolled through it.

At that moment, someone posted a photo of the Lamborghini and Prince Charming Lin Fan in the school’s group chat.

Seeing this, she was startled.

The expressionless face of the beautiful woman in the white dress changed slightly, and she said softly, “ALF666 is Lin Fan? I didn’t expect to meet you so soon.”

After saying that, the beautiful woman in the white dress smiled and looked at the starry sky through the window with her black eyes.

…

Lin Fan had no way of knowing any of this.

After spending more than 20,000 yuan at Penglai Seafood Restaurant, he returned to his dormitory.

Song Yi, Zheng Jinbao, and Ma Zhong were all lying on the bed with their round bellies, groaning and moaning. They did not want to move at all.

They had eaten too much.

Lin Fan looked at their pained and happy expressions and did not know whether to laugh or cry.

Then, he took out his phone and looked at the bright red packet on the screen. He muttered in his heart, ‘222 red packets. Let’s see what I can get.’

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received three yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 10,00 yuan.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained a Medical Water Illustration Card.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 30,000 yuan.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received the skill ‘Pianist-Level Performance’.]

…

Out of the 222 red packets, Lin Fan received a total of 550,000 yuan.

Lin Fan was not too bothered by this.

His gaze fell directly on the medical water illustration card and Pianist-Level Performance.

[Pianist-Level Performance: playing beautiful music can increase charm!]

[Medical Water Illustration Card: Collect 100-year-old ginseng and 100-year-old spiritual branch, then obtain the right to purchase Medical Water. Note: Medical Water is a godly potion that can heal all wounds on the human body.]

The moment Lin Fan saw this, his eyes lit up.

The feeling of having his hands dance freely on the black and white keys would definitely be not bad.

The Medical Water Illustration Card could even allow him to purchase Medical Water that could heal all wounds on the human body!

Lin Tao’s surgery was very successful.

However, his body was still severely injured.

If he had Medical Water, he would be able to completely treat Lin Tao’s body!

Obtain!

He had to get it!
